name: ML2 15-minute variant: available production per turbine and quarter hour
hourly_contract: models/ml2/feature_contract.json (same target definition and hourly features)

target.name: cf15
target.definition: mean power over the quarter hour of a healthy turbine in operation, without stops and curtailment

output: one row per quarter hour: quarter_start (UTC), cf; 7 days of forecast = 168 hourly rows = 672 quarters
output_to_energy: kWh per quarter = clip(cf, 0, 1) * capacity_kw * 0.25; MWh over the week = sum / 1000

quarter_rows.starts: for each forecast hour T: T, T+15 min, T+30 min, T+45 min
quarter_rows.ws: wind_speed_100m interpolated linearly to the quarter centre (T + 7.5 + 15 k min) between the values at T and T + 1 h; the last forecast hour holds its value
quarter_rows.ws_d1, ws_sd3: computed on the hourly wind_speed_100m series as in the hourly contract, applied to the hour's four quarters
quarter_rows.temp: temperature_2m of the hour minus the park reference temperature (farm models only)
quarter_rows.wd_sin, wd_cos: sin/cos of wind_direction_100m of the hour (farm models A and B only)
quarter_rows.hod_sin, hod_cos: local solar time of the quarter centre: (UTC hour + minutes / 60 + (7.5 + 15 k) / 60 + longitude / 15) mod 24
quarter_rows.doy_sin, doy_cos: day of year of the UTC date
quarter_rows.turbine, farm: CARE ids as strings (farm models only)

time_convention: training placed each hourly mean at the centre of its hour; serving treats each Open-Meteo hourly value as the instantaneous wind at forecast_time. Both interpolate a smooth wind to the quarter centre.
missing_values: NaN allowed; wd_sin and wd_cos are NaN for farm C
limits: trained on measured nacelle wind (hourly mean, interpolated), served on forecast wind: metrics are an upper bound
the forecast is hourly, so detail inside the hour cannot be predicted; the quarter profile is a smooth interpolation
